messages:
Sam: Heads up — found a Post-it taped to the communal espresso machine: 'Espresso Espionage: Report all suspects.' Who's running a noir coffee subplot?
Pri: LOL that was me. Low-budget office ARG. Goal: get people to swap anonymous compliments for a free espresso.
Omar: I received an anonymous compliment this morning that said 'Your terminal dotfiles are art.' Not sure if flattering or concerning.
Leah: I got one that said 'You make the calendar feel brave.' Still processing.
Sam: Rules clarification? How do we redeem the espresso without revealing our secret admirer?
Pri: There are three sealed envelopes in the sugar jar. Pick one, follow the mini-mission, and you'll get a token. Tokens redeemed at the machine.
SnackBot: Mini-poll created: "Espresso token missions difficulty"  React with :one: (too easy) :two: (just right) :three: (cryptic). Free biscotti for voters.
Omar: Mission I pulled: leave a Post-it compliment on someone's monitor who sits furthest from the window. Mission status: success. Reward pending.
Leah: I opened an envelope that said 'Balance a paperclip on your nose for five seconds.' Did it. Lost my dignity, gained a token.
Pri: Note: mission "recycle a sticky note into origami crane" is optional but gains bonus flair points.
Facilities: FYI — please avoid attaching anything to the espresso machine itself. We had a sticker residue incident last week.
Sam: Copy that @Facilities. We'll keep all props tabletop-only. Also can we have a tiny badge for 'Espresso Agent' winners?
Pri: I made pixel badges in Figma. Will bring printouts tomorrow.
Omar: Can remote folks participate? @Pri any remote mission ideas?
Pri: Remote missions: email a teammate an obscure emoji poem, or post a throwback photo in #random-pics with a caption. Tag me and I'll send a virtual token.
SnackBot: Reminder: biscotti will be on the counter after 11am for voters. Donut: espresso-ARG participants only.
Leah: This is the nicest covert ops I've ever joined. 10/10 would be surveilled by charming barista again.
Sam: Update: completed mission, redeemed token, crowned 'Espresso Agent #7' with a paperclip ribbon. Photos incoming.
Pri: Photos please. Also: next week's theme is 'Cappuccino Capers.' Consider your disguises.
Omar: Signing off as Agent O. Watch for my next move: latte art shaped like a tiny dinosaur.
